dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: ...I have no plans for you, my child. You're free to pursue what you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Me? I'm just a nobody, don't worry about me. Come, have a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Regardless of what brought you here, surely it's worth having a drink to celebrate our meeting on this ship?

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: To celebrate being able to see the sky and the sea every day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Penny...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Ah, young Penny! She must trust you quite a bit, if she's willing to introduce you to her animal friends.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: What're they called again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Autumn...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: The poor girl... Such a shame that you had to meet like that.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: In fact, she has a good heart. I hope she can be happy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rouge...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: "To see truly wonderful things, you must look with your mind, not your eyes."

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Guess who told me that?

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Haha, he's a funny guy, and a good friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Until next time.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Until next we meet, my child.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Truth is always marching onward, and nothing can stop it! Cheers!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can see it?

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: To see truly wonderful things, you must look with your mind, not your eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: ...Drunk talk, my child.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Believe me, try looking from this angle, and you might just see things differently.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don Quijano.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Yep, that's a name that reeks of Rouge. Like a swordsman's.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: That Tiger-Striped Cat is really something! Ah, when those enemies chased us all the way to Poisson...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Jumping out like some kind of great hero, scratching their faces to ribbons! Haha, such a brave, loyal cat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nana.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah. I remember that's the name of Autumn's dog.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: This dog's too delicate. Grew up in the city, after all, and not used to life in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: I was shocked the first time I heard Autumn say she liked to pick out clothes and necklaces for the dog when she was young.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: So rich that even the dog wears necklaces.
